risk_note: RV2 (catalog/** RV1, openapi.yaml and route-schemas.gen.ts). GET /v1/products/{product_key}: validates the key and item_ref (20001 for a valid-signature ref of another product, before any union call), takes the raw ID by BR-PROD-05 (fresh item_ref, then fresh product_refs, else 30143), reads the union detail through the governed upstream (off shelf 30141, outage 50401 without fabricating from product_refs, union rejection of the raw ID 30143), derives the key with the single deriveProductKey (mismatch or failure 30143), registers product_refs and a new link with the quote snapshot (coupon id included) through the existing card entry and LinkRegistrar; a failed registration fails the request. Parse capability as in parsing (registered platform with an adapter), independent of search.enabled. Removes x-implementation: planned of getProduct only and regenerates route-schemas. Written by hand.
